title: RF and Microwaves
tagline: Transmission lines and the Smith chart, matching, waveguides, S-parameters, microwave circuits and antennas
summary: At high frequencies every wire is a transmission line. This course treats transmission lines and the Smith chart, impedance matching, waveguides, scattering parameters, passive microwave components, amplifier design and antennas, ending with the link budgets of radio and radar systems.

chapters.title: Transmission lines and the Smith chart
chapters.summary: Terminated lines, input impedance, the reflection coefficient and the Smith chart.

chapters.title: Impedance matching
chapters.summary: Lumped L-networks, single-stub and quarter-wave matching, and the bandwidth of matching networks.

chapters.title: Waveguides
chapters.summary: Rectangular and circular waveguides, TE and TM modes, cutoff and dispersion.

chapters.title: Microwave network analysis
chapters.summary: Impedance and scattering matrices, reciprocity and losslessness, and signal-flow graphs.

chapters.title: Passive microwave components
chapters.summary: Power dividers, directional couplers, hybrids, resonators and microwave filters.

chapters.title: RF amplifier design
chapters.summary: Stability circles, maximum gain, low-noise design and noise figure.

chapters.title: Antennas
chapters.summary: Radiation from currents, dipoles and monopoles, gain, directivity, effective aperture and antenna arrays.

chapters.title: Radio links and radar
chapters.summary: Free-space propagation, the Friis equation, link budgets, noise temperature and the radar equation.
